threshold_isodata — SEGMENTATION threshold op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.threshold_isodata(image, *, nbins: 'int' = 256, max_iter: 'int' = 1000) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import seggraph; seggraph.threshold_isodata(image, *, nbins: 'int' = 256, max_iter: 'int' = 1000) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("threshold_isodata"))

Usage

ISODATA (Ridler–Calvard 1978): iterates t ← (μ_≤t + μ_>t)/2 on the pixel values until the partition stops changing (initial value = mean) (threshold_isodata).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

分割が止まれば t は μ を計算し直しても動かない = 不動点 t = (μ_low + μ_high)/2 が厳密に成り立つ(`residual` = 0)。

ヒストグラムの上の不動点(skimage と同じ「ビンの中心 c で 0 ≤ (μ_≤c + μ_>c)/2 − c < ビン幅」)も `fixed_points` で返す。

返す: `threshold、mask = image > t、mu_low / mu_high、residual、n_iter、fixed_points`。
